name: jsonc-lexer
description: Minimal lexical tokenizer for JSONC, that also works for JSON.
author: Rich Plastow

scripts.prebuild: cd wasm/jsonc_lexer && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg && cd ../.. && node scripts/embed-wasm.js
scripts.postbuild: cp dist/* docs/ && echo '\xE2\x9C\x85 Copied builds to docs/ for GitHub Pages!'
scripts.ok: npm run test:js && npm run check-types && npm run build && npm run test:wasm
scripts.test:js: node test.js && echo '\xE2\x9C\x85 All JS tests passed!'
scripts.test:wasm: cd wasm/jsonc_lexer && cargo test --release && echo '\xE2\x9C\x85 All WASM tests passed!'
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:wasm
